rows.note: one for the Hound, one for Lacerten

conditions: No active Kuva Lich, Sister or Technocyte Coda can be running when you spawn a Sister.
Legs does not sell Hound parts; she only assembles them.

rows.label: Requiem mods, one full sequence
rows.note: murmurs from her Hounds reveal the order

bonuses: Oull in the first slot narrows the sequence faster, and every stab spawns another Hound for murmurs; it drops at 25% when a Sister flees a correct sequence.

rows.label: Bhaira Hound
rows.note: Lacerten arrives with any Hound carrying the Bhaira Model
rows.alt: or build one from a traded Bhaira Model blueprint

conditions: Vanquish, never convert: a converted Sister gives no Hound and no blueprint.
The Candidate shows her Tenet weapon but not her Hound; the Model is a hidden 1-in-3 roll.
You can't drop a Sister with the wrong Model; vanquish her and spawn the next.
Don't use a Golden Hand Tribute within about 200m of extraction, or the Candidate may not spawn.
Kill her Hound before downing her, or it self-destructs and the murmur is lost.
bonuses: Every vanquish in the final confrontation gives each squad member a random Hound component blueprint, so a full squad rolls up to four.
The same runs pay out her Tenet weapon.

disclosures.title: the fast Sister loop
disclosures.body: Capture on Hydra, Pluto: wait for the Treasurer, kill him for the next Zenith Crown, then spend it at a Golden Hand Tribute. Run the Granum Void solo, since a squad raises the kill requirement without adding spawns. A Xoris heavy attack, a wide nuke frame, or your Railjack On Call specter trivializes it. A mission spawns at most 3 Hounds about 80 seconds apart, so don't rush the objective.

disclosures.title: building a Bhaira Hound
disclosures.body: The Bhaira Model blueprint is one of 12 random vanquish blueprints, or a trade from another player. It costs 50,000 credits, 5 Spectral Debris (Errant Specters in the Granum Void), 5 Gallium, 2 Marquise Thyst and 10 Eye-Eye Rotoblade, 24h. Pair it with any crafted Core, Bracket and Stabilizer at Legs for 4,000 credits; a built Hound can't be taken apart.
